_comment: Human-gated event/campaign watchlist. Each entry is tracked across the WHOLE archive (retroactive — a new entry gets its full history from first mention). 'match' = lowercased substrings; an article matches if ANY match term appears in its title+summary+entities and NO 'exclude' term does. Keep match terms specific and add excludes to avoid false hits (e.g. a football 'blitz'). track_events.py reads this; it never edits it. NO sentiment — this measures MEDIA attention (coverage), not public opinion or the event's real-world scale.
